rationale: With only 3 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation at the bell, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that gapped up ~16% today with no news catalyst and is trading below VWAP ($12.58) with declining momentum on the last five 1-minute candles. The risk/reward of entering either direction in the final minutes — with a wide intraday range, elevated volatility (VIXY +5.83%), and mandatory close-out — does not justify committing capital.
